designSystem.styleGuidelines:
## Brand & Style

The design system embodies precision environmental stewardship, computational clarity, and industrial circularity. Designed for enterprise sustainability operators, facility managers, and automated sorting platforms, the interface balances clinical, data-dense utility with an optimistic, restorative tone.

The aesthetic fuses **Modern Clean High-Tech** with **Tactile Glassmorphic Minimalism**:
- **Purity & Visibility:** Clean surfaces dominated by cool alabaster backgrounds with hyper-controlled mint tints evoke sterile sorting environments and precision recovery analytics.
- **Dynamic Utility:** Crisp status metrics, stream-specific chromatic signaling, and high-legibility structural grids ensure zero-latency operational decisions.
- **Physicality:** Layered cards with deep rounded radii, micro-frosted backdrops, and tinted ambient emerald shadows create a soft yet structured tactile environment.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout model leverages a 12-column responsive fluid grid with fixed outer bounds for large desktop monitors (max-width `1440px`), ensuring high-density sensor panels remain within the operator's central field of view.

### Responsive Breakpoints
- **Desktop (≥1024px):** 12-column fluid grid. Margin `2rem`, gutter `1.5rem`. Layout maintains side-by-side stream analytics, real-time cameras, and classification queues.
- **Tablet (768px – 1023px):** 8-column fluid grid. Margin `1.5rem`, gutter `1rem`. Secondary side panels collapse into structured bottom sheets or slide-over trays.
- **Mobile (<768px):** 4-column fluid grid. Margin `1rem`, gutter `1rem`. Operational cards reflow into a linear vertical feed. Primary action controls anchor persistently to the bottom navigation bar.

### Spacing Rhythm
Spacing is anchored on an 8pt step system (`4px`, `8px`, `16px`, `24px`, `40px`):
- `space-xs` (4px): In-badge icon gaps, inline badge-to-label alignment.
- `space-sm` (8px): Form input inner paddings, list item micro-separations.
- `space-md` (16px): Card internal structural padding, metric grid gaps.
- `space-lg` (24px): Sectional breaks, card-to-card stack spacing.
- `space-xl` (40px): Major section separations and canvas module boundaries.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy combines subtle green-tinted ambient diffusion with crisp, low-contrast structural borders to preserve industrial clarity without visual clutter.

- **Level 0 (Canvas Base):** Flat `#F8FAFC` canvas. No shadow.
- **Level 1 (Cards & Data Panels):** Background `#FFFFFF`, 1px solid border in `#E2E8F0`. Shadow: `0px 4px 16px -2px rgba(10, 131, 107, 0.04), 0px 2px 6px -1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.03)`.
- **Level 2 (Interactive Hover & Elevated Modules):** Background `#FFFFFF`, 1px solid border in `#CBD5E1`. Shadow: `0px 10px 24px -4px rgba(10, 131, 107, 0.08), 0px 4px 12px -2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04)`.
- **Level 3 (Modals, Overlays & Flyouts):** Background `#FFFFFF` with glassmorphic backdrop-blur (`12px`) on outer scrims. Shadow: `0px 20px 32px -8px rgba(7, 102, 83, 0.12), 0px 8px 16px -4px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06)`.
- **Level 4 (Floating Alerts & Real-Time Toasts):** Background `#0F172A` (or stream alert color), tinted ambient glow matching the stream: Recyclable glow `rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.25)`, Hazardous glow `rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.25)`.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary:** Filled `#0A836B` with white text, `rounded-xl`, font `label-lg`. Micro-transition to `#076653` on hover with subtle emerald glow shadow (`0 4px 12px rgba(10, 131, 107, 0.25)`). Active state scales to `0.98`.
- **Secondary / Ghost:** Transparent background with 1px border `#0A836B` and text `#0A836B`. Hover state applies `#ECFDF5`.
- **Destructive:** Background `#EF4444` with white text; used strictly for sorting line halts, emergency stops, or hazardous overrides.

### Stream Badges & Classification Pills
- **Geometry:** `rounded-full`, padding `4px 12px`, typography `label-sm` (uppercase tracking).
- **Recyclable Stream:** Background `#ECFDF5`, text `#076653`, border `1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3)`. Left status dot `#10B981`.
- **E-Waste Stream:** Background `#F0F9FF`, text `#0369A1`, border `1px solid rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.3)`. Left status dot `#0EA5E9`.
- **Compost Stream:** Background `#FFFBEB`, text `#B45309`, border `1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.3)`. Left status dot `#F59E0B`.
- **Hazardous Stream:** Background `#FEF2F2`, text `#B91C1C`, border `1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3)`. Left status dot `#EF4444`.

### Input Fields
- **Container:** Height `44px`, background `#FFFFFF`, border `1px solid #E2E8F0`, `rounded-xl`, padding `0 14px`, text `body-md` in `#0F172A`.
- **Focus State:** Border color `#0A836B`, ring `3px rgba(10, 131, 107, 0.15)`.
- **Placeholder:** `#64748B`.

### Checkboxes & Radios
- **Checkboxes:** `rounded-md`, border `1.5px solid #CBD5E1`. Checked state fills `#0A836B` with white tick.
- **Radio Buttons:** `rounded-full`, checked state features `#0A836B` outer rim with centered 6px `#0A836B` core.

### Cards & Container Modules
- **Standard Card:** Background `#FFFFFF`, `rounded-2xl`, border `1px solid #E2E8F0`, padding `20px` (`space-lg`), Level 1 shadow.
- **Telemetry Card (Active Sorting Feed):** Outer border shifts to `1px solid #A7F3D0` on target lock, with header bar tinted in `#ECFDF5`.

### Circular Metrics & Purity Gauges
- Specialized recovery rate dials built with SVG ring progress tracks (`#E2E8F0` track base, `#0A836B` stroke head, `#10B981` overflow indicators), typography centered with `headline-md` value and `label-sm` classification index below.

The palette establishes an authoritative hierarchy centered on environmental recovery, paired with unmistakable visual classification indicators for operational waste streams.

- **Surface Elevation (`#FFFFFF`):** Pure white card layer for primary content zones, modular panels, and operational dashboards.
- **Subtle Surface Tint (`#ECFDF5`):** Soft mint wash reserved for highlighted active states, positive scan verification, and selected container surfaces.

### Primary Accents & Hierarchy
- **Iris Primary Teal (`#0A836B`):** Primary interactive elements, verified system operations, active toggles, and primary focal paths.
- **Deep Teal (`#076653`):** High-contrast interactive hover states, emphasized primary headers, and high-priority metrics.

### Typography & Structure
- **Slate Text Primary (`#0F172A`):** Core readable ink for headlines, data points, and critical values.
- **Slate Text Muted (`#64748B`):** Secondary metadata, stream timestamps, inactive states, and unit notations.
- **Surface Border (`#E2E8F0`):** Hairline separation stroke used for cards, dividers, and input borders.

### Waste Classification Streams
- **Recyclable (`#10B981`):** Clean plastics, fibers, metals, and standard municipal recovery.
- **E-Waste (`#0EA5E9`):** Printed circuit boards, micro-electronics, batteries, and rare earth materials.
- **Compost / Organics (`#F59E0B`):** Biodegradable matter, food scrap, agricultural bi-products.
- **Hazardous (`#EF4444`):** Chemical reagents, toxic materials, non-inert residues requiring isolation.

## Shapes

The geometry reflects aerodynamic, modern software engineering through progressive radius hierarchy:
- **Cards & Primary Modules:** Styled strictly with `rounded-2xl` (16px / 1rem) to convey soft, approachable containment while housing sharp visual data.
- **Interactive Form Inputs, Buttons & Table Wrappers:** Implemented with `rounded-xl` (12px / 0.75rem) to reinforce clickable precision.

screens.prompt:
Design the Specimen Detail (/images/:id) screen focused on the 'Community Reuse & Donate (Donate)' section for 'Iris — Waste Classification & Circular Recovery'.

Visual Aesthetic & Design Tokens (Iris Ecological Precision):
- Canvas Background: Warm Alabaster (#fcf8f1)
- Primary Ink: Deep Moss (#13160f)
- Primary Accent: Forest Emerald (#255c27)
- Card Surfaces: Sage Mist (#eef2e6) and Crisp Cream (#ffffff) with 1px solid #d5dccb hairline borders
- Typography: Newsreader serif display headers (font-serif tracking-tight), Plus Jakarta Sans clean UI copy, JetBrains Mono (font-mono) for technical status pills & quantity badges.

Page Structure:
1. Navigation Shell: Consistent with Iris Recovery OS layout, TopNavBar / SideNav breadcrumbs: 'Specimen Feed > Glass Stream > Specimen #GLS-7049'.
2. Top Specimen Context Summary Bar:
   - Compact specimen inspection card with thumbnail image {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_7}} showing 'Vintage Amber Apothecary Glass Jar (500ml)'.
   - Specimen metadata: Classification badge 'Reusable Container • 99% Match' with circular reuse icon, material stream pills ('Glass #70 Cullet', 'Circular Reuse Priority', 'Sterilization Grade A').
   - Fast metrics: Mass '410g', Intrinsic Carbon Offset '310g CO2e saved via reuse', Condition 'Near Mint / Food-Safe'.
   - 'Nearby Drop-off Hubs & Centers' summary strip with fast badges (EcoPonto Vila Madalena • 0.6 km, GreenLoop Depot • 1.4 km).

3. Main Focus — Community Reuse & Donate Section (data-live="donate"):
   - Subtitle: 'Peer-to-Peer Upcycling & Local Reuse Exchange' with active filter tabs ('All Offers (3)', 'Available (1)', 'Handover Complete (2)').
   - Two-column asymmetric layout (7 cols left, 5 cols right):
   - Left Column (7 cols) — Active Community Donations List:
     * Header with icon: 'Community Reuse & Handover Ledger' and live badge '3 Active Offers' in emerald.
     * Card 1 (Open state): Crisp Cream card (#ffffff, border 1px solid #d5dccb, rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm).
       - Header row: Status pill 'open' in emerald (#255c27 bg with white text or tinted emerald), JetBrains Mono quantity pill 'qty: 2', date 'Listed 25m ago'.
       - Pickup note: 'Sterilized 500ml amber glass jars with brass lids — porch pickup near Vila Madalena station after 18h'.
       - Donor profile: Avatar initials 'CM', Neighbor tag '@clara.m • 4.9 ★ (18 handovers)'.
       - Action row: Prominent Forest Emerald CTA button 'Claim for Reuse' (phx-click="claim-donation") with interactive hover state.
       - Secondary two-tap <details> disclosure styled neatly: '<summary class="cursor-pointer text-xs font-semibold text-stone-500 hover:text-stone-700">Retract Offer</summary>' with nested confirm button 'Confirm Retract' (phx-click="retract-donation", styled in terracotta red #b91c1c with warning note 'Cancels listing immediately').
     * Card 2 (Claimed state): Crisp Cream card (#ffffff, border 1px solid #d5dccb, rounded-xl p-5 opacity-95).
       - Header row: Status pill 'claimed' in warm amber/gold badge, JetBrains Mono quantity pill 'qty: 1', handover timer 'Pickup scheduled within 4h'.
       - Pickup note: 'Crate of 6 mason jars for home preserves — Lobby desk handover'.
       - Handover pair: Offered by '@lucas.r' → Claimed by '@marina.eco'.
       - Secure handover verification code snippet: 'Handover Token: IRIS-8942'.
     * Card 3 (Completed state): Sage Mist card (#eef2e6, border 1px solid #d5dccb, rounded-xl p-5 opacity-80).
       - Header row: Status pill 'completed' in muted sage badge with checkmark, JetBrains Mono quantity pill 'qty: 4'.
       - Pickup note: 'Clean glass bottles for kombucha brewing — Handed over at EcoPonto'.
       - Recorded circular impact badge: '1.64 kg Glass Diverted • 0.9 kg CO2e Abated'.

   - Right Column (5 cols) — Offer for Community Reuse Form (id="offer-donation"):
     * Elevated Sage Mist card (#eef2e6, 1px solid #d5dccb, rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-sm sticky top-24).
     * Card Header: 'Offer Specimen for Community Reuse' with subhead 'Keep high-grade glass in local circulation instead of downcycling.'
     * Form elements:
       - Pickup Note & Handover Instructions textarea (name="note", rows="4", placeholder="Describe item condition, pickup window, or neighborhood drop-off spot...")
       - Quantity numeric input with stepper (name="quantity", value="1", with JetBrains Mono unit badge "units available")
       - Preferred Handover Method: Radio/pill selectors ('Porch / Contactless Pickup', 'Direct Meetup', 'Leave at Partner Hub')
       - Safety & Cleanliness verification checkbox ('Specimen has been washed, sanitized, and has no sharp cracks')
       - Full-width Forest Emerald (#255c27) button: 'Offer for Community Reuse' with arrow icon and active click states.
       - Sub-text caption: 'Traceable via Iris Circular Chain • Instant notification sent to 48 verified local reuse members nearby.'

## Brand & Style

The design system embodies precision environmental stewardship, computational clarity, and industrial circularity. Designed for enterprise sustainability operators, facility managers, and automated sorting platforms, the interface balances clinical, data-dense utility with an optimistic, restorative tone.

The aesthetic fuses **Modern Clean High-Tech** with **Tactile Glassmorphic Minimalism**:
- **Purity & Visibility:** Clean surfaces dominated by cool alabaster backgrounds with hyper-controlled mint tints evoke sterile sorting environments and precision recovery analytics.
- **Dynamic Utility:** Crisp status metrics, stream-specific chromatic signaling, and high-legibility structural grids ensure zero-latency operational decisions.
- **Physicality:** Layered cards with deep rounded radii, micro-frosted backdrops, and tinted ambient emerald shadows create a soft yet structured tactile environment.

## Colors

The palette establishes an authoritative hierarchy centered on environmental recovery, paired with unmistakable visual classification indicators for operational waste streams.

### Foundation & Surfaces
- **Canvas (`#F8FAFC`):** Crisp alabaster baseline providing clean, neutral contrast for high-density tables and telemetry feeds.
- **Surface Elevation (`#FFFFFF`):** Pure white card layer for primary content zones, modular panels, and operational dashboards.
- **Subtle Surface Tint (`#ECFDF5`):** Soft mint wash reserved for highlighted active states, positive scan verification, and selected container surfaces.

### Primary Accents & Hierarchy
- **Iris Primary Teal (`#0A836B`):** Primary interactive elements, verified system operations, active toggles, and primary focal paths.
- **Deep Teal (`#076653`):** High-contrast interactive hover states, emphasized primary headers, and high-priority metrics.

### Typography & Structure
- **Slate Text Primary (`#0F172A`):** Core readable ink for headlines, data points, and critical values.
- **Slate Text Muted (`#64748B`):** Secondary metadata, stream timestamps, inactive states, and unit notations.
- **Surface Border (`#E2E8F0`):** Hairline separation stroke used for cards, dividers, and input borders.

### Waste Classification Streams
- **Recyclable (`#10B981`):** Clean plastics, fibers, metals, and standard municipal recovery.
- **E-Waste (`#0EA5E9`):** Printed circuit boards, micro-electronics, batteries, and rare earth materials.
- **Compost / Organics (`#F59E0B`):** Biodegradable matter, food scrap, agricultural bi-products.
- **Hazardous (`#EF4444`):** Chemical reagents, toxic materials, non-inert residues requiring isolation.

## Typography

The typographic pairing balances modern structural engineering with pristine screen legibility:
- **Headings & Key Metrics (`Plus Jakarta Sans`):** Provides a contemporary, geometric warmth with crisp geometric forms. Ideal for dynamic sensor metrics, classification scores, and facility KPIs.
- **Body & Data Displays (`Inter`):** Selected for its neutral, highly engineered optical metrics. Ensures high scan-rates in telemetry streams, tabular categorization, and continuous operational logging.
- **Badge & Action Labels (`Plus Jakarta Sans`):** Slightly elevated tracking on uppercase and semi-bold strings to guarantee instant recognition on conveyor and stream identification badges.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout model leverages a 12-column responsive fluid grid with fixed outer bounds for large desktop monitors (max-width `1440px`), ensuring high-density sensor panels remain within the operator's central field of view.

### Responsive Breakpoints
- **Desktop (≥1024px):** 12-column fluid grid. Margin `2rem`, gutter `1.5rem`. Layout maintains side-by-side stream analytics, real-time cameras, and classification queues.
- **Tablet (768px – 1023px):** 8-column fluid grid. Margin `1.5rem`, gutter `1rem`. Secondary side panels collapse into structured bottom sheets or slide-over trays.
- **Mobile (<768px):** 4-column fluid grid. Margin `1rem`, gutter `1rem`. Operational cards reflow into a linear vertical feed. Primary action controls anchor persistently to the bottom navigation bar.

### Spacing Rhythm
Spacing is anchored on an 8pt step system (`4px`, `8px`, `16px`, `24px`, `40px`):
- `space-xs` (4px): In-badge icon gaps, inline badge-to-label alignment.
- `space-sm` (8px): Form input inner paddings, list item micro-separations.
- `space-md` (16px): Card internal structural padding, metric grid gaps.
- `space-lg` (24px): Sectional breaks, card-to-card stack spacing.
- `space-xl` (40px): Major section separations and canvas module boundaries.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy combines subtle green-tinted ambient diffusion with crisp, low-contrast structural borders to preserve industrial clarity without visual clutter.

- **Level 0 (Canvas Base):** Flat `#F8FAFC` canvas. No shadow.
- **Level 1 (Cards & Data Panels):** Background `#FFFFFF`, 1px solid border in `#E2E8F0`. Shadow: `0px 4px 16px -2px rgba(10, 131, 107, 0.04), 0px 2px 6px -1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.03)`.

The geometry reflects aerodynamic, modern software engineering through progressive radius hierarchy:
- **Cards & Primary Modules:** Styled strictly with `rounded-2xl` (16px / 1rem) to convey soft, approachable containment while housing sharp visual data.
- **Interactive Form Inputs, Buttons & Table Wrappers:** Implemented with `rounded-xl` (12px / 0.75rem) to reinforce clickable precision.
- **Stream Badges, Micro-Tags & Circular Avatars:** Built with `rounded-full` (9999px) to establish instant classification recognition as autonomous, pill-shaped physical tags.
- **System Checkboxes & Sliders:** Micro-radii of `rounded-md` (6px) to match high-density control requirements.

outputComponents.text:
I have designed and published the **Specimen Detail (`/images/:id`)** screen focused on the **Community Reuse & Donate** section for **Iris — Waste Classification & Circular Recovery**.

### Key Design & Architecture Highlights:
- **Ecological Precision Aesthetic**: Built upon a warm alabaster background (`#fcf8f1`) with deep moss typography, sage mist (`#eef2e6`), and crisp cream card surfaces bordered by refined hairline rules (`#d5dccb`). Editorial headers use serif typography paired with Plus Jakarta Sans body and monospace badges (JetBrains Mono) for inventory metrics.
- **Top Specimen Context Bar**: Embeds high-fidelity specimen imagery (`Vintage Amber Apothecary Glass Jar 500ml`), AI classification confidence pill (`Reusable Container • 99% Match`), material stream indicators (`#70 Cullet`), mass & net carbon avoidance figures, and a quick-glance nearby verified drop-off hubs strip.
- **Asymmetric Community Reuse Ledger (7/5 grid)**:
  - **Left Column (7 cols)**: Live ledger featuring 3 distinct state representations:
    1. *Open State*: Features emerald status pill, quantity badge (`qty: 2`), pickup instructions from `@clara.m`, prominent `Claim for Reuse` action, and an accessible two-step `<details>` disclosure with a terracotta red `Confirm Retract` trigger.
    2. *Claimed State*: Warm amber tag with scheduled handover window, donor-to-recipient linkage, and a secure verification token snippet (`IRIS-8942`).
    3. *Completed State*: Muted sage completion ledger entry showing closed loop circular metrics (`1.64 kg Glass Diverted`).
  - **Right Column (5 cols)**: Sticky Sage Mist card housing the **Offer for Community Reuse** form with detailed handover method selectors, condition verification checkbox, quantity stepper, and a full-width Forest Emerald primary CTA.
